checklists.title: The S.T.O.P. Protocol
checklists.description: A learned cognitive discipline designed to interrupt the stress response and establish a clear path forward.
steps: Stop: Pause what you are doing immediately.
Take a breath: Focus on your breathing to center yourself.
Observe: Notice what is happening inside you and around you.
Proceed: Continue with a conscious, intentional choice.

checklists.title: Cognitive Reset Matrix
checklists.description: Visualizing the psychological arc of a crisis to move from mental paralysis to decisive action.

checklists.title: MARCH Algorithm
checklists.description: Advanced trauma treatment protocol for massive hemorrhage, airway, and circulation management.
steps: Airway: Establish and maintain a patent airway.
Respiration: Decompress suspected tension pneumothorax, seal open chest wounds, and support ventilation/oxygenation as required.
Circulation: Assess for shock and IV/IO access.
Head injury/Hypothermia: Prevent/treat hypotension and hypoxia to prevent worsening of traumatic brain injury and prevent/treat hypothermia.

checklists.title: Water Purification
checklists.description: Essential methods for making water safe to drink in survival situations.
steps: Filter: Remove large debris using cloth or a bottle filter.
Boil: Bring water to a rolling boil for at least 1 minute (3 minutes at high altitude).
Chemical Treatment: Use iodine or chlorine tablets if boiling is not possible.
UV Treatment: Expose clear water to direct sunlight in a clear bottle for 6 hours (SODIS method).
